rows.claim: Published request and agency response; not an appropriation or solicitation.
rows.explanation: In Community District Three, many single-family homeowners and senior residents face financial challenges that can make everyday expenses, such as the cost of garbage bins, difficult to manage. Given the vital role these bins play in maintaining cleanliness and sanitation across our community, we respectfully request a cost reduction on garbage bins for single-family homeowners and senior residents. We believe that reducing the cost of garbage bins for single-family homeowners and seniors would positively impact both individual households and the broader community. This measure would not only alleviate financial pressure on vulnerable residents but also promote a cleaner, healthier, and more cohesive neighborhood for all.
rows.headline: Other expense budget request for DSNY
rows.response: OMB supports the agency's position as follows: Agency supports but cannot accommodate Explanation: In the fall, the City provided reimbursement to 1-2 unit property owners who were part of the State's STAR tax relief program and who had purchased a garbage bin through the official system. Additional funding for reimbursements is not available at this time.
